AS message FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.represent_yn = 'Y' AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT lc.card_code AS cardId, lc.user_id AS userId, c.card_num AS cardNum, c.expiry_date AS expiryDate, lc.represent_yn AS representYn FROM linked_card_tbl lc INNER JOIN card_tbl c ON lc.card_code = c.card_code WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND lc.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY lc.card_code DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO linked_card_tbl ( user_id, card_code, card_company_code, represent_yn, delete_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{cardCode}, COALESCE(#{cardCompanyCode}, 'KB'), #{representYn}, 'N' )

mapper.select: SELECT c.card_transaction_id AS cardTransactionId, c.linked_card_id AS linkedCardId, c.status AS status, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.transaction_id AS transactionId, f.amount AS amount, f.merchant_name AS merchantName FROM card_transaction_detail_tbl c LEFT JOIN financial_transaction_tbl f ON c.transaction_id = f.transaction_id WHERE c.card_transaction_id = #{cardTransactionId}

SELECT card_transaction_id AS cardTransactionId, linked_card_id AS linkedCardId, status AS status, created_at AS createdAt, transaction_id AS transactionId FROM card_transaction_detail_tbl WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY card_transaction_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.card_transaction_id AS cardTransactionId, d.linked_card_id AS linkedCardId, d.status AS status, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.transaction_id AS transactionId FROM card_transaction_detail_tbl d INNER JOIN linked_card_tbl lc ON d.linked_card_id = lc.linked_card_id WHERE lc.user_id = #{userId} AND d.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY d.card_transaction_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM linked_card_tbl WHERE linked_card_id = #{linkedCardId} LIMIT 1
SELECT account_id FROM account_dummy_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY account_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT account_id FROM account_dummy_tbl WHERE owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{merchantName}, '%') ORDER BY account_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM account_dummy_tbl WHERE account_id = #{accountId} LIMIT 1
SELECT balance FROM wallet_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
